[[Zarek the Tamer]] is a [[pet tamer]], a type of NPC who allows players to remove their current [[Animal companion|pet]] in order to gain a new one.

==Locations==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|Ferndale}} (outside [[House zu Heltzer]])

==Dialogue==
{{dialogue-stub}}
:''"Greetings, <character name>. My name is Zarek the Tamer. I've traveled the world in search of creatures both common and exotic for the [[Emperor Kisu|emperor]]'s menagerie. You look like the adventuring type. Would you like me to take a look at your pet?"''
::'''What do you do with the animals you collect?'''
::''"I am in the emperor's service, tasked with searching lands far and wide for animals to add to his great menagerie. The emperor has quite a soft spot for the creatures of the earth, air, and sea."''
